subject: Urgent: LumenForge throughput spike & quality change after quant-profile-v2 rollout
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@lumenforge.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@lumenforge.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Production: sudden latency & hallucination rate after 2/17 update

Diego —

We started seeing a sharp uptick in token latency (p50→p95) and a spike in semantically incorrect outputs after your team rolled the "quant-profile-v2" model variant overnight (2/17). This hit our inference cluster at ~07:30 UTC and has impacted our chat product traffic.

Symptoms observed:
- p50 latency up ~30ms, p95 up ~160ms (baseline before rollout)
- 4.8% increase in output mismatch rate on our regression prompts (critical for compliance)
- sporadic 502s at the Redwood API gateway for some requests

I've attached a small sample of error cases and a pprof trace. We downgraded our traffic to the previous model alias and saw partial improvement, but quality artifacts persist. Need immediate assistance — this is hitting our SLAs and we may need exec visibility.

Attachments: lumenforge_error_samples.json, pprof_trace_20260218.pb.gz

— Jamie Park
CTO, LumenForge

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@lumenforge.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & hallucination rate after 2/17 update

Jamie — thanks for the quick report and the attachments. I'm escalating to infra & model ops immediately.

Immediate steps from our side:
1) Marcus is pulling the rollout manifest and perf diffs now.
2) We've queued a temporary traffic rule to pin your tenant to the pre-2/17 model alias while we investigate — you should see routing switch within 15 minutes.
3) We'll produce a short incident note and ETA for rollback if needed.

I'm adding Steph to coordinate communications and Evelyn for exec visibility given SLA exposure. Will follow up within 2 hours with findings.

— Diego
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc:
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & hallucination rate after 2/17 update

Diego / Steph — initial triage notes below (quick dump):

What I checked:
- Rollout manifest (rollout_manifest-20260217.yaml) shows quantization profile v2 deployed to the 2nd-stage pool with kernel selection changes for attention kernels.
- Perf diffs comparing v1 -> v2 on representative traces show increased memory pressure and a fallback to slower kernel paths for sequences >512 tokens on Ampere GPUs used by the 2nd-stage pool. This explains the P95 latency jumps.
- The hallucination/quality regression likely stems from slight fp16→int8 quant mapping differences in certain attention heads — some sensitive prompts see logits shift.

Evidence attached: perf diffs (p95_bench.csv) and the pprof trace Jamie sent. I recommend two-prong mitigation:
A) Immediate: rollback the quant-profile-v2 on the 2nd-stage pool and re-route LumenForge traffic to the pre-2/17 variant (low risk).
B) Near-term: create a patched quant mapping for sensitive heads and re-run accuracy evals on LumenForge regression prompts before re-rollout.

I'll prepare a short runbook for rollback steps and coordinate with infra to ensure no config drift.

— Marcus
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@lumenforge.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & hallucination rate after 2/17 update

Jamie —

Thanks for the patience. We have enacted the temporary routing pin to the pre-2/17 alias; you should see baseline latency within the next 10–15 minutes. Marcus's team recommends a rollback of quant-profile-v2 from the 2nd-stage GPU pool to prevent further exposure while we run a targeted quant mapping patch.

Planned actions (timeline):
- 09:30 UTC: pin traffic (done)
- 10:00 UTC: rollback quant-profile-v2 on 2nd-stage pool (low-risk)
- 12:00 UTC: run targeted accuracy evals on your regression set and share results

If you prefer immediate full rollback across all pools, we can do that but it may briefly affect throughput while we sync configs — Marcus can advise.

Steph will coordinate communication once we have the before/after metrics. We're treating this with exec priority.

— Diego

From: Jamie Park <jamie@lumenforge.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@lumenforge.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & hallucination rate after 2/17 update

Diego / Steph — thanks for the fast action. Two asks from our side:
1) Can you loop in someone from product/ops leadership for SLA/credit discussion if this stretches beyond today?
2) Please include the exact test vectors and seed configs you will use for the targeted accuracy eval so we can validate results on our side.

We've copied Procurement — we may pause renewal signatures until this is stabilized depending on impact. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

— Jamie

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@lumenforge.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: LumenForge incident status & exec summary (LF-4237)

Jamie — quick executive summary and next steps.

1) What happened: quant-profile-v2 introduced kernel selection changes and an aggressive int8 mapping for a subset of attention heads. On Ampere hardware with sequences >512 tokens this led to kernel fallbacks and higher p95 latency; on certain prompts the mapping produced logits shifts leading to an elevated mismatch rate.

2) Remediation completed: rolled back quant-profile-v2 from the 2nd-stage pool and pinned your tenant to pre-2/17 model alias on 2/18 at ~09:30 UTC. Post-rollback metrics show p95 latency returned to baseline within 20 minutes; mismatch rate reduced to within your SLOs on the sampled regression set. Artifacts: rollout_manifest-20260217.yaml, pprof_trace_20260218.pb.gz.

3) Next steps (ownership):
- Marcus (Model Ops): implement patched quant mapping for sensitive heads and run extended evals with your test vectors (ETA 48–72h).
- Steph (CS): coordinate customer validation and communications; share test vectors and seed configs (today).
- Diego (AE): coordinate SLA/credit discussion; loop in Evelyn for executive decisions if requested.

4) Ask from us: please confirm if you want a full fleet rollback or the staged rollback we did. Also share your extended regression set; we will run the same evals and post raw diffs to the HubSpot ticket.

We've opened an internal incident ticket and will follow up with a technical postmortem and timeline for a safe re-roll. Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your product and we're prioritizing resolution.

— Diego Fernandez
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
